In this case, the action that comes first is Having met you. It is clear that the action I don't remember comes last.

How to fill out a feedback form for the hotel

Hotel guests will occasionally be disappointed with something during their hotel stay.
Staff should anticipate complaints and devise strategies to help staff effectively resolve the situation.
When guests are able to express their opinions, both the hotel and the guest benefit. Hotels learn of potential problems or valid concerns and have the opportunity to resolve them.
Feedback forms are often given to guests at the time of departure, either at checkout or placed in their guest room. Also, online feedback has become increasingly popular.
Guests can express their opinions on different areas such as service, room, amenities and overall experience.

images.text: Adam: Hmm, I was asked to complete a feedback form at the hotel, but I prefer to do it now, in my own time. Having experienced poor customer service while at the hotel, I will access the form online rather than communicate with them directly.

Customer Feedback Form
Do you wish to give us feedback? Yes
Date of visit: October 5th - October 8th
Feedback type (Positive, Negative or Neutral): Negative
The feedback concerns *
☐ Product ☐ Service ☐ Facilities ☐ Cleanliness ☐ Other (e.g. web site) ________
I am going to answer "Service".

Feedback *

Unfortunately, our stay at your hotel was not a pleasant one. Despite having booked well in advance, we were told that our reservation didn't exist in the computer system. We then proceeded to wait for over twenty-five minutes at the counter while the receptionist attempted to retrieve our information. Our original booking had also included two deluxe rooms, city views and late checkout; however, that information was unavailable. It was only when we provided a booking receipt that the receptionist begrudgingly gave us the key to our room.

Having made our way to the fifth floor, we  were shocked to find that our rooms had not yet been serviced.  Towels were scattered on the floor, the beds were unmade and the bathrooms were filthy. A cleaner was casually chatting on her cellphone near the elevators with no interest in assisting us with our predicament. Having waited for almost twenty minutes, she ended the call complaining that she could barely hear her friend due to our conversation.  Her unprofessional demeanor and sarcastic tone were not well received.  Being subjected to substandard service is unacceptable, particularly at the price point. Having stayed at your hotel, I would not recommend it to anyone in the future.
